subject: Staging playbook handovers & ramp checkpoints
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Staging playbook handovers & ramp checkpoints

Team —

We're a week out from the first staging ramp window and I want to make sure the playbook handovers are clear and owners are lined up. Attached is the latest staging_runbook_v3.pdf (high level) — key questions below: 

- Who will own the canary run and rollback decision on Day 0?
- Who's the doc owner for troubleshooting KB (step-by-step runbook snippets)?
- Can we confirm enablement/training slots for CS + Solutions next week?
- Any roadblocks from product/PM on the tolerances (error rate/latency) we should bake into the checklist?

Proposed quick plan:  
- Thu 03/03: dry run + canary checklist walk-through (30m)
- Fri 03/04: final doc freeze for runbook and KB
- Mon 03/07: staged ramp begins (canary -> 10% -> 50%)

Please reply with owners and any exceptions you need by EOD today so I can update the playbook and inform Acme Analytics.

Thanks,
Mina
Sr. Program Manager, Product Launches
Redwood Inference

Attachments: staging_runbook_v3.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-28T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Staging playbook handovers & ramp checkpoints

Thanks Mina — quick responses inline then a few asks.

- Canary run owner: I can own the canary validation for infra and model-serving metrics. I'll make the final rollback call for infra-related signals (OOMs, tail latency breaches).
- Doc owner for troubleshooting KB: Grace, will you take lead on KB snippets? If yes I'll slot the KB review on Thu.
- Enablement/training: I can run two 45m sessions (CS + Solutions) on Friday morning.

Clarifying Qs:
- What thresholds do we want for automated rollback vs. manual? I suggest automated for severe infra faults (node OOM, service crash) and manual for model-quality regressions.

I attached an updated canary-checklist.xlsx with suggested metric thresholds and a short validation script block.

Marissa
Director, Site Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachments: canary-checklist.xlsx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-01T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Staging playbook handovers & ramp checkpoints

Mina/Marissa —

Agree with the owners as proposed. Two roadmap constraints to flag that affect the ramp timeline:

1) Model patch 1.2.1 (latency-optimized) is scheduled for Tuesday 03/08 in the release plan; if we accelerate the staged ramp to start 03/07 we won't have the patch in prod for the 10% stage. If Acme needs the latency improvement earlier, we need to either delay ramp start by 48 hours or accept baseline perf for the first week.

2) Documentation exception: the product notes for new sampling parameters are still in draft. I can approve the release of the staging KB with a "draft - do not cite externally" banner, but Product wants final wording for public-facing docs before formal sign-off. That means the KB owner may need a small exception window to update wording after the initial canary.

If we need no-exception (no drafts) we should push the final doc freeze to Mon 03/07 instead of Fri 03/04. That will cascade the training schedule.

Karthik
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-01T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Staging playbook handovers & ramp checkpoints

On Mon, Mar 1, 2027 at 08:23 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Documentation exception: the product notes for new sampling parameters are still in draft.

I can take doc ownership for the troubleshooting KB and do the rapid edits post-canary, but we need to be explicit about what is allowed to change after the canary. Proposal:

- Freeze "runbook steps" and "rollback criteria" by Fri 03/04.
- Allow wording updates and public-facing doc polishing until Mon 03/07 (minor edits only; no procedural changes).
- Any procedural changes after 03/04 require sign-off from Karthik + Marissa.

I've created a Confluence staging page and added the runbook with the "draft" banner: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENG/Staging+Ramp+Playbook.

Training slots: I confirm Fri 03/04 09:00 and 10:00 PT for CS + Solutions. I'll upload the slide deck and short demo recording to the Confluence page by EOD Thu.

Grace
Manager, Developer Enablement
Redwood Inference

From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Analytics <eng@acme-analytics.com>
Date: 2027-03-02T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Staging playbook handovers & ramp checkpoints — confirmed plan

Thanks all — consolidating next steps and owners so we have a single canonical plan I can share with Acme: 

- Canary validation owner: Marissa Cole (infra & model-serving metrics) — final rollback call for infra signals.
- Doc & KB owner: Grace O'Connor (troubleshooting KB + slide deck). Grace will perform wording edits through Mon 03/07; no procedural changes without Karthik + Marissa sign-off.
- Training: Marissa to run two enablement sessions on Fri 03/04 09:00 & 10:00 PT.
- Ramp timing: Start Mon 03/07. NOTE: Karthik flagged that Model patch 1.2.1 lands on Tue 03/08; if Acme requires the latency patch before their traffic we should delay start by 48 hours.

Action items: 
- Marissa: upload canary-checklist.xlsx to Confluence and add validation script snippet (due Thu 03/03 EOD).
- Grace: publish slide deck + demo to the Confluence page (due Thu 03/03 EOD).
- Karthik: confirm whether the product team can move 1.2.1 earlier or accept a phased patch (due Fri 03/04).
- Mina: I will send the final playbook and a short note to Acme with the agreed timeline once everyone confirms.

If anyone needs to raise an exception to the freeze rules above, call out the specific change and owner. Otherwise I will mark the playbook ready and share with Acme tomorrow morning.

Mina
Sr. Program Manager, Product Launches
Redwood Inference
